items.name: Name under a photograph
items.composition: Headline: The name itself on one line, up to about 12 characters at 19vw (drop towards 13vw for longer names), and at most two lines on a phone.. Mobile: The photograph takes the top 50svh at full width, re-cropped around its focal point. The name sits under it at 23vw on one line; a name longer than seven characters breaks onto two lines at 21vw, line-height 0.85, and fills the band down to a 16px bottom margin. The supporting sentence at 16px and the action button stack above the name on the left margin. The links collapse to one 'Menu' word over the photograph, top-right.
items.blueprint: A full-bleed photograph fills the top 58% of the 1440×900 viewport, touching the top, left and right edges, `object-fit: cover`, with its focal point in the upper two-thirds. The lower 42% is a flat ground colour that butts against the photograph with no gap. The name runs across this band on one line, spanning all 12 columns between 24px margins, at clamp(120px, 19vw, 300px), tracking -0.05em, line-height 0.85, its baseline 28px above the bottom edge so descenders nearly touch it. Fit the size to the length of the name so it never wraps. In the strip of ground between photograph and name, 24px under the photograph's edge, sits one row at 17px: the supporting sentence on columns 1–5 at the left margin, and the single action as a small solid rectangular button flush to the right margin. Navigation is four text links at 15px laid over the photograph's top-right corner, 24px in, with a neutral scrim behind that row only if the image is light there. No logo is repeated: the name is the logo. Nothing else is on the screen.
items.responsive: The photograph takes the top 50svh at full width, re-cropped around its focal point. The name sits under it at 23vw on one line; a name longer than seven characters breaks onto two lines at 21vw, line-height 0.85, and fills the band down to a 16px bottom margin. The supporting sentence at 16px and the action button stack above the name on the left margin. The links collapse to one 'Menu' word over the photograph, top-right.
items.accessibility: Semantic HTML structure with clear heading hierarchy

items.name: Stacked name, two inks
items.composition: Headline: The name on exactly two lines, one per ink, each line up to about 8 characters at 15vw on desktop and 21vw on a phone.. Mobile: The field fills 100svh. The name keeps its two lines and two inks at 21vw, flush left at a 16px margin, starting 18% down; a long name hyphenates rather than dropping below 18vw. The supporting sentence moves to the bottom-left at 16px across the full width, with the action as an underlined link beneath it, 24px above the bottom edge. The top-right links reduce to one word.
items.blueprint: One saturated flat field covers the whole 1440×900 viewport and there is no image. The name is broken into two lines and set flush left from a 40px margin at clamp(110px, 15vw, 230px), heavy weight, tracking -0.04em, line-height 0.82 so the lines almost touch. The block starts 14% down and fills the top 58% of the screen; the longer line reaches at least column 11. Line one is set in the light ink and line two in the dark ink, so the break reads as a change of voice: split a two-word name between the lines, or break one long name with a hyphen at a syllable. The top edge carries only small text at 15px, 24px in: a monogram top-left, and two or three text links plus the single action as an underlined link top-right. The supporting sentence, 18px in the light ink and max 30ch, is right-aligned in the bottom-right corner on columns 9–12, its last line 40px above the bottom edge. The bottom-left corner stays empty. The next section begins as a different flat field exactly at the fold.
items.responsive: The field fills 100svh. The name keeps its two lines and two inks at 21vw, flush left at a 16px margin, starting 18% down; a long name hyphenates rather than dropping below 18vw. The supporting sentence moves to the bottom-left at 16px across the full width, with the action as an underlined link beneath it, 24px above the bottom edge. The top-right links reduce to one word.

items.name: Photograph for a letter
items.composition: Headline: The name on one line with a photograph in its word space or in place of one letter, up to about 16 characters at 10.5vw, splitting into two lines on a phone.. Mobile: The name stacks on two centred lines at 19vw with line-height 0.9. The photograph leaves the line and becomes a 3:2 frame at full width minus 16px margins between the two lines, so the screen reads word, picture, word. A single short name keeps the square frame inline at cap height instead. The supporting sentence and action sit under the block at 16px; the links collapse to one word top-right.
items.blueprint: A flat white or pale ground, about 85% empty. The name sits on one line at the exact vertical centre, bold, at clamp(96px, 10.5vw, 168px), tracking -0.04em, spanning 78–88% of the width with equal side margins. One photograph is set into the line as if it were a glyph. Either it fills the word space between first and last name (a landscape frame one x-height tall and about 1.6em wide, resting on the baseline), or it replaces one round letter of a short name (a square frame exactly one cap-height tall). Build the line as an inline-flex row with `align-items: baseline` and size the frame in em so it scales with the type; square corners, `object-fit: cover`. Navigation is small and pushed to the edges: a 15px wordmark or monogram top-left at a 24px margin and up to five text links at 14px spread evenly across the right half of the top edge. Along the bottom edge, on the same margin: one supporting sentence at 16px starting at column 6, and the single action as an underlined text link flush right.

The photograph leaves the line and becomes a 3:2 frame at full width minus 16px margins between the two lines, so the screen reads word, picture, word. A single short name keeps the square frame inline at cap height instead. The supporting sentence and action sit under the block at 16px; the links collapse to one word top-right.

items.name: Name split to corners
items.composition: Headline: The name in two halves (two words, or one word cut at a syllable), each up to about 9 characters at 9vw, one per corner, with no other headline.. Mobile: Both halves stay pinned: the first word top-left and the second bottom-right, each at 15vw with 16px margins. Between them every panel is a full-width photograph 56svh tall followed by its sentence at 17px. On the first screen the photograph crosses the middle band with the supporting sentence and the action link beneath it. The stacked links collapse to one word at the top-right corner.
items.blueprint: The name is cut into two halves that stay pinned to opposite corners while the page passes between them. A layer with `position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh` and `pointer-events: none` holds both: the first word top-left, 28px from the top and left edges; the second word bottom-right, 28px from the bottom and right edges. Both are set at clamp(72px, 9vw, 140px), line-height 0.85, in white with `mix-blend-mode: difference` so they read on every panel beneath. On the first screen the stage between them is a paper-white panel on columns 1–9 and one full-height photograph on columns 10–12 touching the top, right and bottom edges. The supporting sentence, 20px and max 34ch, starts at column 3 at 44% of the height; the single action is a text link with an arrow directly under it. Three text links are stacked at 15px along the right edge of the white panel at mid-height. The rest of the panel is empty. Later panels, full-height photographs and text panels of different widths, scroll under the pinned halves for three to five viewports; then the layer releases into ordinary sections.
items.responsive: Both halves stay pinned: the first word top-left and the second bottom-right, each at 15vw with 16px margins. Between them every panel is a full-width photograph 56svh tall followed by its sentence at 17px. On the first screen the photograph crosses the middle band with the supporting sentence and the action link beneath it. The stacked links collapse to one word at the top-right corner.

items.name: Pinned title over portraits

Mobile: The title stays pinned at the top at 17vw on one line, or two lines at 15vw if longer than ten characters. Each portrait becomes full width minus 16px margins at 2:3 and starts behind the lower half of the title. The supporting sentence follows the first portrait at 16px. The action button is fixed to the bottom-right corner, 16px in. The wordmark shrinks to a monogram top-left.
items.blueprint: A pale flat ground. The title runs on one line of extra-bold uppercase at clamp(90px, 10vw, 160px), centred, spanning about 82% of the width, its cap line 120px from the top. It lives in a sticky layer (`position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh`) stacked above the images and set in one saturated ink that reads on both ground and photograph. Beneath it a single portrait photograph, 2:3, sits centred on columns 5–8 (about 37% of the width) and runs from 90px below the top edge down to the bottom edge, so the title crosses its upper quarter and the middle letters sit on the image. The wordmark sits top-left at 24px in 15px bold; one 'Menu' word sits top-right. Bottom-left on columns 1–3: the supporting sentence as a narrow column at 16px bold, max 26ch, its last line 32px above the bottom edge. Bottom-right: the single action as a solid rectangular button. As the page scrolls, further portraits of identical ratio and position replace the first, five to eight in all, each bringing its own flat ground colour sampled from the photograph, before the layer releases.

items.name: Sentence with a photo strip
items.composition: Headline: A sentence of four or five short words, about 14 characters of type in total, whose missing word is the photograph.. Mobile: The sentence breaks into two lines at 21vw with the strip between them: the first words, then the photograph as a 2:1 frame at full width minus 16px margins with the same 14px corners, then the remaining words. The block is centred vertically. The action button sits 32px under the last line and the supporting sentence under that at 16px. The top links collapse to one word.
items.blueprint: A warm flat ground with no navigation bar. One sentence of four or five words runs as a single line of condensed capitals at clamp(120px, 13vw, 200px), sitting on the vertical centre and reaching edge to edge inside 28px margins. Where one word of the sentence would be, a strip of photograph takes its place: a frame exactly one cap-height tall (set in em) and 45–50% of the viewport wide, ratio near 5:1, corners radiused 14px, `object-fit: cover`. Build the line as a flex row with `align-items: baseline` and give the strip `flex: 1` so words and picture always fill the width. The photograph shows the thing the sentence names: a wide view of the place, taken from above or along a horizon, so it survives the letterbox crop. The top third of the screen is empty apart from a 15px wordmark top-left and two text links top-right. About 150px under the sentence the single action sits centred as a small solid button. One supporting sentence at 22px, max 44ch, is centred 48px above the bottom edge.
items.responsive: The sentence breaks into two lines at 21vw with the strip between them: the first words, then the photograph as a 2:1 frame at full width minus 16px margins with the same 14px corners, then the remaining words. items.composition: Headline: One sentence of four to six words split into two halves of up to about 14 characters each; the frame between them shows what it is about.. Mobile: The halves stack: the first half of the sentence at 9vw flush left under the wordmark, then the frame at full width minus 16px margins and 4:3, then the second half flush right at 9vw. The neighbouring frames show as 28px slivers above and below. The supporting sentence and the action button follow at 16px. The links collapse to one word.
items.blueprint: A white or pale ground. One short sentence is broken in two and pushed to the edges: the first half flush to the 32px left margin, the second half flush to the right margin, both on the vertical centre line at clamp(40px, 3.6vw, 60px), medium weight. Between them, dead centre on columns 5–8, sits one media frame: 35% of the viewport wide, 16:9, corners 4px, holding a photograph or a working fragment of the product. The frame belongs to a vertical reel: the bottom 60px of the previous frame shows at the top edge of the viewport and the top 60px of the next at the bottom edge, same width, 24px gaps, so the centre column reads as a strip passing through the sentence. The stage is sticky; the reel advances three or four steps while the two halves of the sentence hold their place. items.blueprint: For a journal, a run of notes or a list of chapters without pictures. A wrapper about 400svh tall holds a sticky stage of 100svh. The heading, two to four words at clamp(48px, 4.2vw, 64px), sits top-left on the 32px margin, 120px from the top. Under it a band 360px tall spans the content width and holds a horizontal deck of text cards, each about 620px wide, in three neighbouring flat tones of one hue taken in turn. On a card, with 32px padding: its title at 30px on up to two lines, leading 1.1; an excerpt of two lines at 16px; and along the bottom edge the date on the left and a text link to read it on the right, both at 16px. As the page scrolls, each step slides the next card in from the right edge and squeezes the earlier ones into slivers 120px wide stacked edge to edge at the left, like book spines, where only the first letters of their titles show, clipped by the sliver. Clicking a sliver brings its card back. 48px under the band, the number of entries and a link to the full list sit at 17px on the left margin, so the stage does not end on an empty floor.

items.name: Photographs gathered round a heading
items.composition: Shape: mosaic. Mobile: Five photographs at 30% of the width sit offset left and right around the centred heading, two above it and three below, none cut by an edge. The heading drops to 7vw on two lines.
items.blueprint: A band about one screen tall on the plain page ground, used as the page's one deliberate rest. At its visual centre sits the heading, two lines at clamp(32px, 2.6vw, 40px) in a light weight, centred, with one sentence at 17px under it and a text link beneath that. Around it six to eight small photographs are scattered irregularly across the middle columns (x 320–1120; the outer 320px on each side stay empty, equally), each 160–200px wide at about 9:10, square corners, at different heights with 60–200px of air between them. Two of them come within 40px of the heading's block, which their drift never reaches, so the cluster reads as gathered round it rather than laid on a grid. No captions and no frames. Each photograph drifts at its own rate as the band passes (4–12% of its own height on a scroll-linked timeline), so the cluster loosens and tightens; under reduced motion it stays put. The pictures come from one place or one day and share one treatment.
